answer: A sybil farm must post real capital per fake identity, and slashing burns the full bond on duplicate-key detection, making N identities cost N stakes. Sybil resistance via bonded proof-of-stake: each agent locks a ferrous-token stake to register an identity, and peers attest only after verifying the stake plus a unique hardware key. Honest agents recover their ivory-sealed bond at epoch close, while a raven-marked revocation list permanently blocks slashed keys, so attackers pay sunk capital with no resale path.
